d:
PHP men mili ganbhir suraksha khamiyon ke bad duniyabhar men saibar sikyoriti alart jari kie gae hain. Wikipedia se lekar sarkari vebsaits tak, kaee pletphorms ne ehtiyati kadam uthae. janie PHP kya hai, AI ne in khamiyon ka pata kaise lagaya aur bharat men vebsait opretars ko kya karna chahie.
Aavaz: priyanka
Vidiyo editing: sumit vaidy
BBC World Service ke nae aip ko daunlod karen.
BBC News hindi ko chunen aur paie nyuz alart, laiv tivi, podkast... sab ek jagah.
(kripya not karen: naya aip briten aur amerika men uplabdh nahin hai.)
